Welcome to the Finology Academy of Mutual Funds!
In this sixth episode, we explore the middle ground between equity growth and debt safety, decoding all seven hybrid fund categories, uncovering the tax trick (and hidden catch) behind Arbitrage funds, and walking through Gold, International, and SEBI’s brand-new 2026 Life Cycle funds.
Key concepts explained in this episode:
• Why do hybrid funds exist, and how do the 7 hybrid categories differ in equity share and taxation?
• How do Balanced Advantage (Dynamic Asset Allocation) funds shift between equity and debt?
